:::{#exm-countable-additivity}
#### Counting elements is countably additive

For the counting function $\measure(A) \eqdef \abs{A}$ of @exm-finite-additivity,
take any sequence of pairwise disjoint sets $A_1, A_2, \ldots$.
No two of them share an element, and $D$ has only six elements,
so at most six of the $A_i$ contain any elements;
the rest are $\emptyset$, with $\measure(\emptyset) = 0$.
The infinite sum therefore has at most six nonzero terms,
and finite additivity (@exm-finite-additivity) shows that those terms
add up to $\measure$ of the union.
So $\measure$ is countably additive.

:::
